label: MA5671A GPON SFP ONT
description: Huawei MA5671A mini-PON ONT built into an SFP module: a single SC/APC GPON port on the fibre side (2.488 Gbit/s down, 1.244 Gbit/s up) and an HSGMII host interface on the SFP edge connector, so there is no RJ45 and no Wi-Fi anywhere on the unit. Managed over its own web UI, SSH or the 115200 baud UART on the SFP pins.
